title: Filtering the sorted gate arguments
statement: Let $g$ be a gate whose argument list is strictly increasing, and suppose every argument is less than $V$. Then filtering the list $0,1,\ldots,V-1$ to retain exactly the entries that occur as arguments of $g$ returns the argument list of $g$.
